items.title: Bobby Watson interviewed by Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, January 19, 1996
items.q: Bobby was interviewed at Hamilton College by Michael Woods on January 19

ctx.x: Bobby Watson is one of the most well known alto saxophonists of his generation. He was born in Lawrence, Kansas in 1953 and received degrees in theory and composition from the University of Miami. His move to New York was rewarded by becoming a member of Art Blakey’s Jazz Messengers. Bobby acted as the group’s musical director, and composed and recorded some of the band’s memorable tunes. Bobby was interviewed at Hamilton College by Michael Woods on January 19,

We are filming today for Hamilton College and we’re developing a Jazz Archive. We are blessed to have with us Bobby Watson, an incredible saxophone artist, who is going to perform for us tonight. Bobby, tell us a little bit about how you got started playing the sax. How old were you?
